pr_title: planner: fix create binding panic when status.record-db-qp enable
pr_body:
<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/29503

Problem Summary:
1. We forget to check the `nil` for `ast.SelectStmt.From`. When we create the empty table query, it will cause panic. E.g, `select 1`.
2. We forget to assign `tableInfo` and `dbInfo` to `ast.StmtNode` when we create the binding and the config [record-db-qps](https://docs.pingcap.com/zh/tidb/stable/tidb-configuration-file#record-db-qps) enable.
3. We forget to check the `nil` in `getStmtDbLabel` function for `*ast.CreateBindingStmt`, it will cause panic when the table is empty.

### What is changed and how it works?
1. Check the `nil` for `ast.SelectStmt.From`.
2. Assign `tableInfo` and `dbInfo` to `ast.StmtNode` when we create the binding and the config [record-db-qps](https://docs.pingcap.com/zh/tidb/stable/tidb-configuration-file#record-db-qps) enable.
3. Check the `nil` in `getStmtDbLabel` function for `*ast.CreateBindingStmt`.
